baseline: 7db2cd83 (main: chore: release cli v1.1.2) — every line anchor below is against this head
summary: Seven ordered tasks for one implementer, one PR against sjawhar/legion on branch legion/LEGION-10, every changed file under scripts/smoke/. Tasks 1-6 each end in a passing harness case and one `jj commit <paths>`; Task 7 runs the whole gate, pushes, opens the PR. Then the tester runs testerE2E on this box and fills the PR's E2E section.

scope.pr: one PR, base main, head legion/LEGION-10, body carries `Dispatch: LEGION-10`
untouched: the gates: block in write_daemon_config (fixed in #941; only its harness guard lands here)
anything under packages/ (github-apps.ts identity lookup, LEGION-6 socket/token work, resync admission behaviour)
no docs/plans file — acceptance 6 forbids files outside scripts/smoke/, so this plan.json is the plan

prerequisites: bun install --frozen-lockfile at the workspace root (done 2026-09-12 in this workspace; Task 1's `bun run packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts` needs node_modules)
bash 5, jq, sed (GNU: the `s/…/…\n…/` newline replacement in Task 1 relies on it), bun 1.3.x — all present on this box

Run each harness with the pane's LEGION_OMP_PATH left alone: every resolve_omp_path case controls the variable itself (subshell `unset`/assignment), so no shell hygiene is required for up.test.sh; the tester's real up.sh run must `unset LEGION_OMP_PATH` (testerE2E.prerequisites).
globalConstraints: Every changed file under scripts/smoke/; bash -n clean; up.test.sh, checkpoints.test.sh, down.test.sh pass (Acceptance 6).
The gates: block in write_daemon_config is left exactly as it is (`gates:\n  design: root-issues`).
omp_pin stays github:sjawhar/oh-my-pi@18.1.15-sami.20260908-220934 and legion.yaml keeps `omp_invocation: mise x ${omp_pin} -- omp`.
resolve_omp_path never falls back to the pin (Rejected); LEGION_OMP_PATH is exported only in the daemon's start_process env block.
The curl --fail / fail path of ensure_root_issue is unchanged; only the payload gains force: true.
checkpoints 8 and 13 keep their current gating; no checkpoint ever reports FAILED for something none mode cannot reach.

Commit with `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" commit -m <msg> <paths>` (paths listed per task) so the working copy's `.omp/config.yml` never enters a commit; never `jj abandon`, never `jj edit @-`, never `jj op restore` (worker skill).

refinementsToSpec.why: environment.ts configuredPath (49-56) throws `LEGION_OMP_PATH must be an absolute executable path` at daemon startup; without this check the failure moves from preflight (spec: 'stops before starting anything') to a daemon that has already been launched. refinementsToSpec.what: checkpoints.test.sh records `envoy` (not `none`) for the checkpoint 1-4 OK cases and for the bare-dir root-issue case
refinementsToSpec.why: Mechanical consequence of the spec's own checkpoints.sh change: those cases would otherwise become false failures / be pre-empted by the new block.

refinementsToSpec.what: checkpoints.test.sh's none-mode case loops over 1 2 3 4 12 (not just 1) and asserts zero Dispatch requests were made
refinementsToSpec.why: Same code path, one loop; guards the case arm against a typo and locks 'blocked before any network call' and 'blocked before SMOKE_QUEUED_ISSUE is required' for 12.

observationsForArchitect: forward mode also has no Dispatch issue-event ingress (gh webhook forward carries GitHub events only; only the envoy bridge relays notifications.dispatch.issue.>), so checkpoints 1-4 and 12 are unreachable in forward mode too. The spec scopes the block to none mode and says 'envoy is the mode for 1-4 and 12', which is accurate; the plan does not gate forward mode. Flagging only so the README wording never implies forward reaches 1-4.

The daemon writes no dedicated 'controller ready' log line (routes/controller.ts:11-28 has no console call). The tester's daemon-log evidence for acceptance 3 is the forced-resync `[legion] resync complete:` line /controller/ready triggers plus the persisted role claim in state.json; the plan spells that out so the PR does not overclaim.
The workspace's working copy holds an empty `.omp/config.yml` added by provisioning; every commit command in this plan names its paths so it never lands in the PR (acceptance 6).

code: **Which OMP build the rig runs.** `up.sh` picks the OMP binary during preflight (`resolve_omp_path`) and exports it as `LEGION_OMP_PATH` in the daemon's environment only. If `LEGION_OMP_PATH` is already exported it must name an absolute executable file, otherwise `up.sh` stops before starting anything and names the path. If it is unset, `up.sh` uses the build production runs, `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/legion/sjawhar-legion/omp/omp-18.1.15-sami.9bff2014-rpcfix`, when that file is executable. If neither exists, `up.sh` stops naming the default path and both remedies (export `LEGION_OMP_PATH`, or raise `omp_pin`). The generated `legion.yaml` keeps `omp_invocation: mise x <pin> -- omp` because the daemon's loader requires that form; its `environment.ts` honours `LEGION_OMP_PATH` over it, so every controller, root, and worker pane runs the selected binary, which `up.sh` prints as `GREEN OMP build: <path>`. The default is a stop-gap: the pinned release predates oh-my-pi `fix/rpc-extension-send-rejection` (commit `0e57a6ca`), without which a headless controller crashes on its first prompt with `send did not invoke the agent`. Bumping `omp_pin` to a tagged release that carries the fix retires the default.

skeleton: Fixes the four smoke-rig defects from dispatch://LEGION-10/spec (v11), all under scripts/smoke/:
1. ensure_root_issue sends `force: true` (Dispatch near-duplicate check trips on the fixed title prefix; LEGSMOKE keeps every prior root).

2. resolve_omp_path picks the rpc-fix OMP build in preflight (LEGION_OMP_PATH if set and executable, else production's ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/legion/sjawhar-legion/omp/omp-18.1.15-sami.9bff2014-rpcfix), exports it to the daemon only, fails closed naming both remedies; omp_invocation stays `mise x <pin> -- omp`.

3. none mode tells the truth: no Dispatch issue event reaches the rig NATS, the root is never admitted, checkpoints 1-4 and 12 are SKIPPED-BLOCKED (exit 3) with a Dispatch-ingress reason; README rows/paragraphs match up.sh stdout and checkpoints.sh.
4. up.test.sh runs the real daemon loader (--check-config) against the generated legion.yaml and proves the pre-#941 `gates.merge` block is rejected (the #941 fix itself is untouched).

**E2E:** (tester) none-mode up.sh on this box with ${SMOKE_DIR}/root-issue absent → `CREATED root issue LEGSMOKE-<n>` (read back from Dispatch); controller ready record in state.json + `[legion] resync complete` line; /proc/<pid>/exe == the printed `GREEN OMP build` path; 0 hits for `send did not invoke the agent` in daemon.log and the controller pane. Full `checkpoints.sh 1 2 3 4 12 13` output: <paste>. down.sh after none → RIG DOWN; envoy-mode up.sh → RIG READY; down.sh → RIG DOWN. forward mode is proven by down.test.sh only because agents lack a user-authenticated gh identity. Harnesses at head: up.test.sh <n> PASS, checkpoints.test.sh <n> PASS, down.test.sh <n> PASS; bash -n clean on all six scripts.

Negative control: the same root-issue POST without `force` → HTTP 409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE; `LEGION_OMP_PATH=/nonexistent bash scripts/smoke/up.sh` → `error: LEGION_OMP_PATH is not an absolute executable file: /nonexistent`, nothing started.
